parts.label: (i)
parts.answer: Foot: $\frac32\mathbf i+\frac32\mathbf j+3\mathbf k$. Reflection: $2\mathbf i+\mathbf j+2\mathbf k$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
EITHER:
Find $\overrightarrow{AP}$ for a general point $P$ on $l$ with parameter $\lambda$, e.g. $(8+3\lambda,-3-\lambda,4+2\lambda)$. (B1
Equate scalar product of $\overrightarrow{AP}$ and direction vector of $l$ to zero and solve for $\lambda$. M1
Obtain $\lambda=-\frac52$ and foot of perpendicular $\frac32\mathbf i+\frac32\mathbf j+3\mathbf k$. A1
Carry out a complete method for finding the position vector of the reflection of $A$ in $l$. M1
Obtain answer $2\mathbf i+\mathbf j+2\mathbf k$. A1)
OR:
Find $\overrightarrow{AP}$ for a general point $P$ on $l$ with parameter $\lambda$, e.g. $(8+3\lambda,-3-\lambda,4+2\lambda)$. (B1
Differentiate $|\overrightarrow{AP}|^2$ and solve for $\lambda$ at minimum. M1
Obtain $\lambda=-\frac52$ and foot of perpendicular $\frac32\mathbf i+\frac32\mathbf j+3\mathbf k$. A1
Carry out a complete method for finding the position vector of the reflection of $A$ in $l$. M1
Obtain answer $2\mathbf i+\mathbf j+2\mathbf k$. A1)
Total [5]

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
EITHER:
Use scalar product to obtain an equation in $a,b,c$, e.g. $3a-b+2c=0$. (B1
Form a second relevant equation, e.g. $9a-b+8c=0$, and solve for one ratio, e.g. $a:b$. M1
Obtain final answer $a:b:c=1:1:-1$ and state plane equation $x+y-z=0$. A1)
OR1:
Attempt to calculate vector product of two relevant vectors, e.g. $(3\mathbf i-\mathbf j+2\mathbf k)\times(9\mathbf i-\mathbf j+8\mathbf k)$. (M1
Obtain two correct components. A1
Obtain correct answer, e.g. $-6\mathbf i-6\mathbf j+6\mathbf k$, and state plane equation $-x-y+z=0$. A1)
OR2:
Using a relevant point and relevant vectors, attempt to form a 2-parameter equation for the plane, e.g. $\mathbf r=6\mathbf i+6\mathbf k+s(3\mathbf i-\mathbf j+2\mathbf k)+t(9\mathbf i-\mathbf j+8\mathbf k)$. (M1
State 3 correct equations in $x,y,z,s,t$. A1
Eliminate $s$ and $t$ and state plane equation $x+y-z=0$, or equivalent. A1)
OR3:
Using a relevant point and relevant vectors, attempt to form a determinant equation for the plane, e.g. $\begin{vmatrix}x-3&y-1&z-4\\3&-1&2\\9&-1&8\end{vmatrix}=0$. (M1
Expand a correct determinant and obtain two correct cofactors. A1
Obtain answer $-6x-6y+6z=0$, or equivalent. A1)
Total [3]

parts.label: (iii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
EITHER:
Using the correct processes, divide the scalar product of $\overrightarrow{OA}$ and a normal to the plane by the modulus of the normal or make a recognisable attempt to apply the perpendicular formula. (M1
Obtain a correct expression in any form, e.g. $\frac{1+2-4}{\sqrt{1^2+1^2+(-1)^2}}$, or equivalent. A1 FT
Obtain answer $\frac1{\sqrt3}$, or exact equivalent. A1)
OR1:
Obtain equation of the parallel plane through $A$, e.g. $x+y-z=-1$. (B1 FT
[The f.t. is on the plane found in part (ii).]
Use correct method to find its distance from the origin. M1
Obtain answer $\frac1{\sqrt3}$, or exact equivalent. A1)
OR2:
Form equation for the intersection of the perpendicular through $A$ and the plane. (B1 FT
[FT on their $\mathbf n$.]
Solve for $\lambda$. M1
$|\lambda\mathbf n|=\frac1{\sqrt3}$. A1)
Total [3]
